description: Grades a brand's location pages together, the free multi-location grader: robots.txt asked first, so a site closed to mttr is not read; then its home page and sitemap, and up to 25 location pages, state and city listings followed down to the places and subpages every location has left out. Eight checks, each passing or not with what was found in words, the locations that fail it with why, and the fix: the brand tied to its locations in structured data, a LocalBusiness block with street and telephone on each, no two locations with the same title, heading, description or most of their words, a share card naming each location, hreflang both ways with an x-default, each location its own canonical, a locations page and the sitemap listing them all, and the address and telephone on the page matching the block. A score from 0 to 100 is the share of checks passed. It cannot say whether a business is really at an address.
